en: Proverbs 15

p.src: 1  A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

ja: えは憤りを退けるが、 厳しい
en: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
u.src: 1  A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

p.src: 2  The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

en: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.
u.src: 2  The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

p.src: 3  The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

en: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
u.src: 3  The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

p.src: 4  A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

ja: であるが、 よこしまな舌は心を打ち
en: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
u.src: 4  A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

p.src: 5  A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

ja: 訓を侮るが、 叱責に心を留める
en: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
u.src: 5  A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

p.src: 6  In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
u.src: 6  In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

p.src: 7  The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

en: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
u.src: 7  The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

p.src: 8  The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

en: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
u.src: 8  The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

p.src: 9  The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

en: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
u.src: 9  The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

p.src: 10  There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

ja: しい訓練があり、 叱責を
en: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.
u.src: 10  There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

p.src: 11  Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

ja: は、なおさらではないか。
en: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
u.src: 11  Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

ja: 15:11 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 15:11 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 12  A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

ja: は叱責されることを好まず、
en: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
u.src: 12  A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

p.src: 13  A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

ja: が痛むと気力はくじかれる。
en: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
u.src: 13  A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

p.src: 14  The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

en: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
u.src: 14  The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

p.src: 15  All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

en: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
u.src: 15  All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

p.src: 16  Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.

ja: を恐れるほうが、 多くの
en: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.
u.src: 16  Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.

p.src: 17  Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

en: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
u.src: 17  Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

p.src: 18  A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

en: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
u.src: 18  A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

p.src: 19  The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

en: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
u.src: 19  The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

p.src: 20  A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

en: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
u.src: 20  A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

p.src: 21  Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

en: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
u.src: 21  Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

p.src: 22  Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

ja: ければ計画は確かなものとなる。
en: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
u.src: 22  Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

p.src: 23  Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

en: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
u.src: 23  Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

p.src: 24  The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

ja: は知恵のある者を上へ導き、 よみに下ることから彼を遠ざける。
en: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
u.src: 24  The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

ja: 15:24 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 15:24 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 25  The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

ja: を根こそぎにするが、 やもめの
en: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
u.src: 25  The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

p.src: 26  The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

ja: われるが、 純粋な者の思いは喜ばれる。
en: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
u.src: 26  The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

p.src: 27  He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

ja: を悩ませるが、 賄賂を
en: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
u.src: 27  He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

p.src: 28  The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

ja: えるが、 悪しき者の
en: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
u.src: 28  The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

p.src: 29  The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

ja: れているが、 義人の
en: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
u.src: 29  The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

p.src: 30  The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

en: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
u.src: 30  The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

p.src: 31  The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

en: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
u.src: 31  The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

p.src: 32  He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

ja: 自身を侮るが、 叱責に耳を傾ける
en: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
u.src: 32  He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

p.src: 33  The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

ja: つのはへりくだりである。
en: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
u.src: 33  The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
